description_en: You can invoke ListCallDetailRecords to obtain a list of call details filtered by specified search conditions under a specified instance. This API is no longer iteratively updated. We recommend that you use the ListCallDetailRecordsV2 API instead
description_zh: 调用ListCallDetailRecords获取指定实例下指定搜索条件过滤后的通话详情列表。接口不再迭代更新，建议优先使用ListCallDetailRecordsV2接口
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-call-detail-records --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --start-time 1532448000000 --end-time 1532707199000 --contact-type Outbound --contact-disposition Success --contact-id job-125152394144120000 --agent-id agent@ccc-test --skill-group-id skillgroup@ccc-test --sort-order DESC --instance-id ccc-test --order-by-field startTime --criteria phoneNumber_:_0735 --calling-number 073539880000 --called-number 13205230000 --satisfaction-list 1_,_3 --satisfaction-survey-channel IVR --satisfaction-description-list '满意_,_一般' --early-media-state-list NotConnected_,_NoAnswer --contact-disposition-list Success_,_NoAnswer --contact-type-list Internal_,_Inbound --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCallDetailRecords

parameters.description_en: Filter by disposition type. Note: Disposition reasons such as voicemail, transfer to agent failed, queuing timeout, queuing overflow, and IVR abnormal are only displayed if the customer has configured a disposition reason node. If no such node is configured and there is no transfer-to-agent module in the IVR, the disposition reason defaults to "Abandoned in IVR".
parameters.description_zh: 按挂断类型过滤，注意：语音邮箱、转人工失败、排队超时、排队溢出、IVR异常的挂断原因需要客户配置挂断原因节点才能体现出来，如果没有配置且IVR中无转人工模块，这时候的挂断原因默认为IVR放弃。
